native_mechanisms: Doubled shadow: all equal-letter crossings (match cells) are revealed at once by a single simultaneous pass over both ropes, without visiting cells one by one
Bare-floor pricing by arithmetic: the cost between consecutive treasures is computed from the index gaps on each rope, never by filling or walking the intervening cells
Per-treasure dominance pruning with a one-slip budget: at each match keep only the best tally in each of two states (slip spent / slip unspent) and drop costlier arrivals
core_technique: Anti-diagonal SIMD (AVX2) Needleman-Wunsch with a 3-row rolling buffer, restricted to a band whose half-width is derived from a greedy/narrow-sweep score lower bound via the standard score-bound certificate (n - 5*w <= lb), with scalar full-DP fallback — i.e. classic banded/vectorised NW (KSW2/Ukkonen style).
